backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Lists two UI features with affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for multiple frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Defines base Tailwind layers and OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling state, evasive button logic, celebration mode, and background animation.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationOverl: Overlay showing timed fireworks, sparkles, and floating hearts after celebration triggers.
frontend/src/components/InitialBackgroun: Generates floating particle elements with randomized styling for the initial background.
frontend/src/config/valentineConfig.ts: Static configuration with prompt text and celebration messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and refreshing an IC actor based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvasiveButton.ts: Hook computing random safe positions for the evasive 'No' button.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity auth provider and hook managing identity load, login, and state.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, light/dark theme color variables, global styles, and custom animations for the gradient background and floating-particle effect on the initial page.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, plugins, and extended theme values using CSS variables.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, existing features, and a pending request related to replacing the initial background animation.
